comment: The fixture brute, with the stats of D-777 and D-781, and the size of D-789 (D-557, D-786). The level and the experience follow D-977. A win rolls the gold from the low gold to the high gold (D-1157). It names the fixture bash, a heavy melee strike (D-955). PR-17 writes the enemies of the first playable. Its name is a common noun, so a battle line writes it in lower case after the start (D-1358).
